user.title: New search
user.description: Give this search a name. You can add multiple searches.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: All filters combine: a message must match every filled-in filter. Within one filter (e.g. two regios) any value matches. Postcodes and the zone use a 5 km radius and count as one location filter.

data_description.diensten: Only messages for these services (police, fire brigade, ...).
data_description.postcodes: Comma separated, 4 digits or 4 digits and 2 letters, e.g. 1234AB, 5678. Radius 5 km.
data_description.zone: Use the postcode at the center of this zone (radius 5 km).
data_description.all_lifeliners: Also report every Lifeliner message, regardless of regio.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to check for new messages (minimum 15).

error.invalid_postcode: Invalid postcode. Use 4 digits, optionally followed by 2 letters.
error.zone_not_found: Zone not found or without coordinates.
error.zone_no_postcode: The center of this zone has no known postcode.
error.no_location_filter: Fill in at least one of regio, postcode, capcode or zone.

zone_no_postcode.title: Zone center has no known postcode
zone_no_postcode.description: The center of {zone} (search “{search}”) is not near a known postcode. Move the zone center or add a postcode to the search. The last known postcode is still used.

zone_missing.title: Zone not found
zone_missing.description: The zone {zone} used by search “{search}” no longer exists or has no coordinates. Restore the zone or choose another zone in the search options. The last known postcode is still used.
